relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological agents such as suzetrigine, VX-150, and A-803467 exert their effect by stabilizing the inactivated state of the channel, thereby reducing afferent nociceptive transmission without impairing sensory or motor function.

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine significantly reduced pain scores at both time points.

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine significantly reduced the risk of nausea (RR = 0.63; 95% CI, 0.42–0.95; I2 = 13.8%) and dizziness (RR = 0.57; 95% CI, 0.34–0.96; I2 = 0%).

key_findings: Meta-analysis of 4 RCT datasets (n=1584): suzetrigine reduced NPRS pain by about 0.93 at 24 h and 1.02 at 48 h versus placebo.
Suzetrigine lowered the risk of nausea and dizziness; no opioid-sparing conclusion possible.
